# @dxtmisha/figma-ref

> Reactive Vue 3 composables for Figma plugin development.

Bridges asynchronous Figma messaging and plugin state into reactive Vue `ref` and `computed` properties for responsive plugin user interfaces.

## Key Composables

- [useFigmaStorage](src/composables/useFigmaStorage.ts): Reactive Vue ref bound to Figma node persistent storage (`pluginData`) with automatic auto-save.
- [useFigmaClientStorage](src/composables/useFigmaClientStorage.ts): Reactive Vue ref bound to `figma.clientStorage`.
- [useFigmaUiSelected](src/composables/useFigmaUiSelected.ts): Reactive list of currently selected canvas elements.
- [useFigmaFrameSelection](src/composables/useFigmaFrameSelection.ts): Composable to observe and toggle canvas frame selection states.
- [useFigmaUiFrames](src/composables/useFigmaUiFrames.ts): Reactive collection of top-level frames for navigation or layer lists.
- [useFigmaFrameStyles](src/composables/useFigmaFrameStyles.ts): Reactive observer for Figma frame CSS styles and visual properties.

## Optional & AI Resources

- [ai-types.md](ai-types.md): Public TypeScript declarations and return type contracts.
- [README.md](README.md): Vue 3 integration guide and quick start examples.
